_doc: [onboard] The first-minutes story objectives (story/objectives.gd, ui/objective_card.gd). One at a time, in order, each with a one-line why (desc). brief.lines: WREN's one last message in the crash (two subtitle lines), then she is silent until the Signal Tower (story/signal_tower.gd). Objective fields: text (title), desc (the why), hint (shown instead of desc until wait_flag is set), type stat|robot|zone|hub_level|flag|core|tower|upgrade, key, target (absolute: lifetime stats), hex (true: outline the target hex on the ground with its % cleaned), lines (WREN, when the objective starts). Data stays English; tr() at display.

lines: Lumi, it's WREN, the Cradle's caretaker. Your friend up here. Your pod's down, and the relay's failing.
Fix the bench, clear junk for cubes, then build a signal tower to reach me. I'll be [glitch]listen—[/glitch]

objectives.desc: Each chestful of junk pays a few cubes.
A bigger chest means fewer trips to the bin.
Grab more junk at once. At the workbench.
It presses junk into bales. Bales sell for far more.
Cubes feed the recycler. Its power wakes the base.
WREN went silent. Build it at the workbench.
Clean ground is where green can grow again.
A helper keeps cleaning while you work.
lines: The base has power! Enough to build you a helper. Try the Bots tab at the workbench.

objectives.desc: Press B and paint the hexes it should clean.
It carries bales to the scale for you.
Living green charges your Bloom Core.
objectives.hint: Keep clearing ground. Seeds turn up in clean soil.

objectives.desc: A bigger base runs more robots.
lines: The hub can grow now. Rebuild it from the Upgrades tab at the workbench.

objectives.desc: A stronger signal: WREN comes through clearer.
